summary: Reset form controls through HTML reset algorithms and a cancelable reset event.

target.notes: Fire a cancelable reset event; if not canceled, reset each resettable control including dirty value/checkedness and selectedness state.

caveats: Calling the JavaScript method can be shadowed by a form control named 'reset'; source analysis must resolve the builtin method.

tests.name: restores defaults
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.defaultValue='d'; f.append(i); i.value='x'; f.reset(); console.log(i.value);

tests.name: reset can be canceled
tests.input: const f=document.createElement('form'); const i=document.createElement('input'); i.defaultValue='d'; f.append(i); i.value='x'; f.addEventListener('reset',e=>e.preventDefault()); f.reset(); console.log(i.value);
